answer: Remote attestation leverages a hardware trust anchor to validate robotic agents logging floral nectar in a subarctic tundra. To register, each agent must sign challenge nonces using an unextractable private key sealed in a secure enclave. Attackers incur the capital cost of procuring discrete cryptographic chips per identity instead of simulating software clones. However, physical side-channel leakage or compromised manufacturer root keys can silently undermine the hardware guarantees.
